decisions.reason: Reconstructing the nonfunctional iOS translation system does not change the separate Android localization requirement; Android string alignment is already independently represented.
The iOS translation-system reconstruction does not alter Android right-to-left layout support.
Translation-system reconstruction does not necessarily change the independently stated iOS right-to-left layout requirement or any of its current attributes.
Reconstructing iOS localization does not change the app-size objective or the existing image-removal requirement.
The iOS localization-system change has no necessary effect on Android packaging or size-optimization requirements.
The localization-system reconstruction does not change iOS version support, UIWebView replacement, or API-modernization state.
The iOS translation-system reconstruction does not alter the independent Privacy Manifest requirement.
Localization reconstruction does not change the requirement to renew certificates and establish valid iOS signing.
The translation-system change does not modify the independently specified iOS Thinning distribution method.
The iOS localization-system reconstruction does not resolve or alter the separate lifecycle ambiguity concerning the Android Chinese Youku video.
The platform-specific iOS translation reconstruction does not change Android API-level, dependency, or deprecated-API modernization requirements.
